items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026, for this actively exploited flaw, rated CVSS 10.0.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. This update is a regularly scheduled release and should be applied in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover and Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Adobe released security updates on August 11, 2026, and indications of active exploitation have emerged.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. Amasty issued a security release for this and other extensions.
